projects.name: Vidhan-AI
projects.subtitle: Legal RAG with Learning-to-Rank
projects.problem: Indian statutory law involves complex cross-references across statutes. Naive RAG fails because dense embeddings lose precise statutory citations and structure-aware legal context.
architecture: Ingested 200+ statutory documents (~3,000 pages) into 1,390 structure-aware, citation-preserving chunks using ChromaDB + BGE-large-1.5
Hybrid retrieval: dense semantic search + sparse BM25 + exact statutory citation matching
2-stage Learning-to-Rank re-ranker using PyTorch RankNet and LightGBM LambdaRank over cosine similarity, BM25 scores, query-statute overlap, citation presence
Selected LightGBM LambdaRank for production for sub-millisecond CPU inference

projects.name: Valkyrie-AML
projects.subtitle: Agentic Anti-Money-Laundering Platform
projects.problem: AML teams face massive alert volumes and 90%+ false-positive fatigue from legacy rule-based systems. Complex layering techniques require labor-intensive manual graph tracing.
architecture: Random Forest + Isolation Forest trained on 200,000 transactions for zero-day anomaly detection
SHAP value computation per flagged transaction for regulatory explainability
NetworkX graph modeling of fund flows with Personalized PageRank and multi-hop cycle detection for structuring/mule accounts
8-tool LangGraph agent: TransactionRiskAnalyzer, GraphRiskPropagator, FundFlowTracer, AccountEntityResolver, SanctionListChecker, SARDraftingEngine, EvidenceAggregator, DeterministicFallbackHandler

projects.name: Wash Sale Auditor
projects.subtitle: Multi-Broker Tax Loss Harvesting & IRC §1091 Engine
projects.problem: Under IRC §1091 and Rev. Rul. 2008-5, wash sales occur across substantially identical securities within a 61-day window. Brokerages don't communicate, creating hidden liabilities for multi-broker traders.
architecture: Multi-broker ingestion: broker CSVs, OFX (SGML/XML), Plaid API with automated stock-split adjustments
3-tier substantially-identical equivalence engine: exact CUSIP/ticker match, benchmark index ETF mapping, SEC Form N-PORT constituent cosine similarity
61-day sliding-window FIFO matching engine linking loss sales to replacement lots across taxable and tax-advantaged accounts
Cost basis ledger: basis step-up for taxable accounts, permanent loss disallowance for IRA accounts (Rev. Rul. 2008-5), chained wash sale compounding
IRS Form 8949 CSV exporter with adjustment code W for TurboTax/TaxAct/Drake

projects.name: TixRush
projects.subtitle: High-Concurrency Distributed Ticket Booking Platform
projects.problem: Flash-sale ticket drops generate massive concurrent read/write spikes, causing race conditions, double bookings, and inventory leakage during checkout abandonment.
architecture: Atomic seat reservation via Redis Lua scripts with configurable TTL locks (e.g. 10-minute checkout window)
BullMQ workers auto-release locks and notify subscribers via WebSockets on timeout/failure
Socket.io room broadcasting for real-time seat state sync across all connected clients
PostgreSQL with strict transaction isolation for Venues, Screens, Shows, Seat Layouts, Bookings, Dynamic Pricing

projects.name: MarketPulse
projects.subtitle: NIFTY-50 Sentiment & Time-Series Forecasting
projects.problem: Stock market forecasting models often overfit or fail to capture time-varying volatility clustering and macroeconomic sentiment shocks.
architecture: 5+ years of daily price data (~1,250 sessions) for NIFTY-50 index and constituents
Benchmarked ARIMA, SARIMA, ETS, and GARCH(1,1) models
6-fold expanding-window time-series cross-validation to prevent look-ahead leakage
Interactive Shiny dashboard with Plotly charts, ACF/PACF diagnostics, volatility forecasts

projects.name: TimetableGen / FFCS
projects.subtitle: Constraint Satisfaction Problem Scheduler
projects.problem: VIT's Fully Flexible Credit System is an NP-hard scheduling problem where students must select courses and slots without clashes or excessive gaps.
architecture: Local-first Web Worker CSP engine with backtracking, Forward Checking, and MRV heuristics off the main thread
Explores millions of combinatorial slot arrangements in milliseconds without locking the UI
Enforces slot clash elimination, faculty preference ranking, morning/afternoon distribution, credit boundaries

projects.name: BlogIT
projects.subtitle: Gaming Blog Platform with Firebase & Azure OpenAI
projects.problem: Content creators in gaming communities need rich interactive media editors paired with AI drafting tools that understand gaming terminology.
architecture: Custom Tiptap editor supporting gaming markdown, code blocks, embeds, media attachments
Azure OpenAI integration for automated post outlining, summarization, SEO tag generation
Firebase Authentication paired with normalized MongoDB Atlas cluster and Express REST API
Containerized with Docker and CI/CD automation

projects.name: VaultShare
projects.subtitle: Cryptographic API-Driven File Sharing System
projects.problem: Secure, verifiable peer-to-peer file distribution without third-party cloud data hoarding.
architecture: SHA-256 checksum generation on upload to verify data integrity on download
PostgreSQL metadata store for mime types, access permissions, download counters, expirations
Secure streaming via Express backpressure streams instead of buffering full payloads

projects.name: Autonomous Oil Well Choke Controller
projects.subtitle: Intelligent Process Control
projects.problem: Oil and gas well chokes must regulate bottom-hole pressure and flow rates to prevent slugging, gas breakthrough, or formation collapse under stochastic reservoir conditions.
architecture: Mathematical simulation of multiphase flow through variable orifices
Closed-loop adaptive control algorithms dynamically modulating choke valve opening based on sensor telemetry
